notes.subject: פני בכם
notes.rationale: 'set face against' — Tok Pisin i tok 'putim pes long yupela antap', pes i no tanim olgeta

notes.subject: ונגפתם
notes.rationale: KJV 'slain' vs ASV/JPS 'smitten'; hapax-form stem — narapela lain i tanim 'ol i ranurai yupela'

notes.subject: ורדו
notes.rationale: 'to tread down' — Tok Pisin 'bosim olgeta' (rule), literal 'lukluk i go daun long yupela' i no klia

notes.subject: שנאיכם / איביכם
notes.rationale: tupela tok bilong birua i stap klostu — 'ol birua' na 'ol i les long yupela' — olsem Ki 26:16

translation: Na bai mi putim pes bilong mi long yupela antap, na bai ol i paitim yupela i ranumi long hed bilong ol birua bilong yupela, na bai ol i les long yupela i bosim olgeta long yupela, na bai yupela i ranawe, tasol i no gat man i bilong ranim ⟨את⟩ yupela.

tokens.gloss: na bai ol i paitim yupela i ranumi
na bai ol i bosim olgeta
